Pakistan Cricket Board Sacks Players Amid 'Clean-Up' Drive

The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) has removed senior players and coaches following recent Test defeats, initiating a 'clean-up' drive. Reports suggest 'behavioural issues' were a primary reason for the dismissal of players including Mohammad Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq. Selectors have faced scrutiny, and potential changes to the coaching staff are being considered. Mike Hesson's tenure as head coach may continue.
